subtitle.zh: 由 Rspack 驱动的测试框架

slogan.zh: 让构建能力延伸到测试

reuseBuildConfigDesc.en: Use existing Rsbuild or Rspack config so aliases, transforms, and plugins stay consistent in tests.
reuseBuildConfigDesc.zh: 直接使用 Rsbuild 或 Rspack 配置，让 alias、transform 和插件能力在测试中保持一致。

productionAccurateTestingDesc.en: A Bundle-based test execution model that reuses Rspack's dependency graph analysis and build optimizations.
productionAccurateTestingDesc.zh: 采用基于 Bundle 的测试执行模型，复用 Rspack 的依赖图分析与构建优化。

blazingFastDesc.en: Rspack's build optimizations cut the module processing and loading work a test run has to do.
blazingFastDesc.zh: 利用 Rspack 的构建优化，降低测试中的模块处理与加载开销。

realBrowserTestingDesc.en: Run tests in Chromium, Firefox, or WebKit through Browser Mode when a simulated DOM isn't enough.
realBrowserTestingDesc.zh: 通过 Browser Mode 在 Chromium、Firefox、WebKit 中运行测试，验证模拟 DOM 环境难以覆盖的行为。

modernByDefaultDesc.en: TypeScript, ESM, CJS, CSS Modules, and modern JavaScript work out of the box.
modernByDefaultDesc.zh: TypeScript、ESM、CJS、CSS Modules 和现代 JavaScript 开箱即用。

testingReadyDesc.en: Assertions, snapshots, mocks, coverage, and lifecycle hooks are ready when you start.
testingReadyDesc.zh: 断言、快照、Mock、覆盖率和生命周期钩子等能力开箱即用。
